# Fixtures whose expected outcome needs a feature the compiler or stdlib
# does not have yet. tools/fixture_sweep.py reports a listed fixture as
# KNOWN-GAP, apart from the failures, while it fails the way recorded here.
# Once it passes it is GAP-CLOSED, and its line should be removed. Any other
# failure is still a failure.
#
# One fixture per line: path, failure today (an error code such as LNC0006,
# a FAIL-* status, or `any`), owner, reason.

tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/repro_nested_error_match.lani  LNC0005  TBD  nested match with an inner wildcard reports false as unresolved; a separately typed helper executes (docs/library-dependencies.md)

tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/repro_ordinary_string_comparison.lani  LNC0006  TBD  `!=` between a str array element and a string literal is unsupported; see tests/fixtures/generics_backlog/README.md
tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/repro_string_length.lani  LNC0027  P2  `str.len()` has no length metadata to read yet; docs/stdlib-foundation.md dependency 15
tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/typed_constant_transport/explicit-constant-source-v1/dependency_body_local_const.lani  LNC0016  P3  a body-local const as a generic argument needs lexical ordinary-value lookup before nominal binding; must fail explicitly until then (its README)
tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/typed_constant_transport/explicit-constant-source-v1/dependency_computed_const.lani  LNC0027  P3  a computed const as a generic argument needs checked constexpr values before explicit binding; must fail explicitly until then (its README)
tests/fixtures/stdlib_foundation/repro_imported_generic_payload_nested_match.lani  LNC0016  P4  a `match` directly as a match-arm result is not accepted syntax yet; docs/stdlib-foundation.md dependency 64
